retraining.title: Start with the reason for retraining
points: Tell Ashley which step was unclear or what changed. Use the participant’s current plan and the RN’s written instructions.
If an order, dose or procedure changes, contact the RN. Wait for updated directions and any training Ashley requires before performing the changed task.
If a dose may already have been given, stop and call the RN before giving anything else.

retraining.title: Check before you give a dose
points: Match the label to the medication administration record (MAR) three times. Check the right participant, medication, dose, route, time and documentation.
Clean your hands. Use the marked medication device. Read a dosing cup on a level surface at eye level.
Follow the written time window. If the label, time, dose or directions do not match, stop and ask the RN.

retraining.title: Handle a refusal, error or reaction
points: Respect a refusal. Keep the dose secure, notify the RN and document what happened. Never force or hide a dose.
Promptly report a missed, wrong, extra or uncertain dose, even if the participant feels well. Give the medication name, amount, time and what you observed.
Call 911 immediately for severe breathing trouble, throat swelling or unresponsiveness. Then notify the RN and office.

retraining.title: Observe and document
points: Follow the participant’s instructions for checking vital signs and reporting readings. Report new symptoms and changes from their usual condition.
Record the actual time, dose, route and your initials on the MAR after giving the medication. Record a refusal or missed dose accurately.
Tell the next worker what was given, what is pending and what the RN directed.

retraining.title: Show Ashley the corrected step
points: Finish the written exam on this device. Ashley can review your result and work with you on the step that prompted retraining.
Show the corrected step as Ashley directs. Ask her to clarify anything you are unsure about.
Ashley records the task, outcome and any further training needed. Follow her instructions before performing the task again.

annual.title: Review your participant’s current plan
points: Review the current plan and RN instructions for each participant you support. Know which tasks Ashley has authorized you to perform for that person.
Tell the RN about changes in the participant’s condition, medications, doses or procedures.
If instructions have changed or are unclear, stop and contact the RN before performing the task.

annual.title: Check the six medication rights
points: Check the right participant, medication, dose, route, time and documentation. Compare the label with the medication administration record (MAR) three times.
Follow the ordered route and written time window. Ask the RN about a late or uncertain dose.
Stay with the participant until the dose is taken. Record what actually happened.

annual.title: Prepare and store medication safely
points: Clean your hands, use clean equipment and measure with a marked medication device. Read a dosing cup at eye level on a level surface.
Keep medications in their labeled packaging and follow the temperature and storage instructions.
Ask the RN before crushing or splitting a medication. Set aside an unreadable or expired package and contact the RN or pharmacy.

annual.title: Check and report changes
points: Use the vital-sign method Ashley taught for this participant. Compare readings with the participant’s usual readings and written reporting limits.
For a seated blood pressure, have the person rest quietly for five minutes with feet flat. Record both numbers and any symptoms.
Report new symptoms or possible reactions promptly. Call 911 for severe breathing trouble, throat swelling or unresponsiveness.

annual.title: Document refusals, errors and given doses
points: Respect a refusal. Tell the RN and document it. Report every medication error promptly, even if the participant looks well.
After a dose is given, record the medication, dose, route, actual time and your initials. For an as-needed dose, document the reason and response.
At shift change, communicate doses given, pending doses and follow-up instructions.

annual.title: Complete your yearly skills evaluation
points: Take the written exam on this device, then meet with Ashley for your participant-specific competency evaluation.
Show Ashley how you perform the authorized tasks for that participant, including how you check, document and report.
Ashley records the evaluation date, participant file reference, tasks and outcome. Follow the tasks and limits she authorizes for that participant.
